blockedIdentities.reason: LINDNER is used by multiple active industrial manufacturers, including recycling-machinery and agricultural-vehicle companies. The raw record has no product, country or legal-name discriminator.
LITZ is a short identity used by unrelated current industrial businesses. The raw record provides no reliable product-scope or legal-entity discriminator for automatic publication.

LJM is a generic three-letter identity shared by multiple active businesses. The source record contains no country, product scope or legal name that can bind it safely to one manufacturer-owned domain.
LUKAS can refer to distinct current industrial manufacturers, including LUKAS Hydraulik and LUKAS-ERZETT abrasives. The undifferentiated raw record does not establish which identity is intended.
The Lumberg name is used for separate current product identities, including Lumberg connectivity products and Belden's Lumberg Automation portfolio. The raw record does not distinguish them.

The raw LÖDIGE / LODIGE record can refer to two distinct active manufacturers: Gebrüder Lödige Maschinenbau for process technology and Lödige Industries for lifting and logistics systems. Spelling normalization alone cannot merge them safely.
MAGNETIC is a generic single-word identity used by multiple industrial brands and companies. The raw record contains no product, country or legal-name discriminator.

Manufacturer-owned magneta HTTPS pages and documents did not establish a working connection during the release check. The product identity is plausible, but publication remains blocked until the official source is reachable.

The manufacturer-owned LeROI product pages returned HTTP 429 during the release check. Identity and product-scope candidates were found, but the strict reachable-source gate is not met and the site was not retried aggressively.

MAHO is a historical machine-tool name associated with Deckel Maho and DMG MORI, but no current manufacturer-owned brand profile establishes MAHO alone as a separately publishable manufacturer identity and product scope.

profiles.shortDescription: Lesjöfors manufactures industrial springs and pressings, including compression, tension, torsion, disc and gas-spring solutions.
fullDescription: Lesjöfors is verified through its official website as a Swedish manufacturer of springs, pressings and related engineered components.
The published portfolio covers compression, tension and torsion springs, disc springs, gas springs, strip components and customer-specific spring solutions for industrial applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Lessmann manufactures technical brushes and brushing tools for deburring, surface finishing, cleaning and industrial processing.
fullDescription: Lessmann is verified through its official website as a German technical-brush manufacturer founded in 1948 and based in Oettingen.
Its range includes wheel, cup, bevel, shank, hand, strip and interior brushes as well as industrial brush solutions used for deburring, cleaning and surface treatment.

profiles.shortDescription: Ligarex supplies industrial clamping and identification systems based on steel bands, clamps, buckles, ties and installation tools.
fullDescription: Ligarex is verified through its official website as a French family industrial-clamping business established in 1939.
Its documented range includes steel and stainless-steel bands, clamps, buckles, cable-management products, identification systems, ties and the tools used to install them.

profiles.shortDescription: LINAK develops electric linear actuators, lifting columns, control systems and integrated motion solutions for industrial and equipment applications.
fullDescription: LINAK is verified through its official website as a Danish manufacturer of electric linear-motion systems headquartered in Guderup, Nordborg.

Its product portfolio includes linear actuators, lifting columns, dual actuators, control boxes, user controls, accessories, desk frames and digital tools used to configure and monitor motion systems.

profiles.shortDescription: LinMot develops linear motors, servo drives, linear-rotary systems and integrated motion modules for industrial automation.
fullDescription: LinMot is verified through NTI AG's official website as a Swiss industrial-motion brand based in Spreitenbach.

The portfolio includes tubular linear motors, linear modules and guides, linear-rotary motors, electric grippers, flat robots, servo drives and controls, configuration software and MagSpring constant-force springs.

profiles.shortDescription: LINSINGER designs milling, sawing, rail-processing and tool systems for heavy industrial metalworking applications.
fullDescription: LINSINGER is verified through its official website as an Austrian machinery manufacturer founded in 1939 and based in Steyrermühl.
Its published technology areas cover milling, sawing, rail processing and tooling for tube and pipe mills, rail infrastructure, wind and offshore structures, shipbuilding and forging operations.

profiles.shortDescription: LiSEC develops machinery, automation and software for cutting, processing and producing flat and insulating glass.
fullDescription: LiSEC is verified through its official download centre as a manufacturer of machinery, automation and software for flat-glass processing.
Its documented catalog scope includes glass cutting, insulating-glass production, laminated-glass production, flat-glass processing, logistics and production software.

profiles.shortDescription: LITEK is LINEARTECK's range of toothed-belt linear units and modules for positioning and industrial automation systems.
fullDescription: LITEK is verified through manufacturer-owned LINEARTECK documentation as an Italian linear-motion product identity.

The official product literature covers modular toothed-belt linear units designed for positioning, transfer and automation duties, with configurations for different travels, loads and installation layouts.

profiles.shortDescription: Little Giant supplies condensate, sump, effluent, utility, sewage, chemical-transfer and specialty pumps for water-handling applications.
fullDescription: Little Giant is verified through its official brand website as a Franklin Electric pump portfolio.

Its published range covers condensate and drain pumps, sump and effluent systems, utility and sewage pumps, chemical-transfer and specialty pumps, submersible well pumps, pressure-boosting packages and water-feature equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: LMI develops chemical-metering pumps and control instruments for dosing, water treatment and industrial process applications.
fullDescription: LMI is verified through its official pump website as a chemical-metering and dosing equipment brand.
The documented portfolio includes solenoid, peristaltic and motor-driven metering pumps, hazardous-duty pump configurations, intelligent pump controls, and conductivity and pH or ORP controllers.

profiles.shortDescription: LOEHRKE develops automated hygiene, cleaning, disinfection, dosing and conveyor-lubrication systems for process plants.
fullDescription: LOEHRKE is verified through Jürgen Löhrke GmbH's official website as a German process-hygiene specialist founded in 1984 and based in Lübeck.

Its systems cover exterior filler cleaning, conveyor lubrication, cleaning-agent storage and dosing, automated and manual plant hygiene, disinfection and CIP-related applications for food and beverage facilities.

profiles.shortDescription: Löser manufactures machinery for grinding, polishing, deburring, superfinishing, hardening and surface-processing operations.
fullDescription: Löser is verified through its official website as a German machine builder based in Speyer.

Its documented product scope includes belt and centreless grinding equipment, polishing and deburring machines, superfinish and microfinish systems, hardening and chrome-plating equipment, and application-specific machinery for cylindrical and flat workpieces.

profiles.shortDescription: Logan Oil Tools is an Innovex fishing-tool portfolio covering downhole catch, milling, cutting, jarring and recovery equipment.
fullDescription: Logan Oil Tools is verified through Innovex International's official product and manual pages as a retained oilfield fishing-tool identity.
The official portfolio includes overshots, spears, junk mills, taper taps, fishing magnets, jars, energizers and bumper subs used to catch, release, cut or recover downhole equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Loher is a Siemens-documented industrial motor identity for application-specific three-phase and low-voltage drive equipment.
fullDescription: Loher is verified through Siemens-owned technical and reference material as an industrial motor identity within Siemens.

Reachable first-party documentation covers Loher three-phase motors, centrifugal-drive applications and brake-motor arrangements, while Siemens reference material documents replacement of an installed Loher motor in a process plant.

profiles.shortDescription: Lombardini is an engine brand for compact diesel power units used in industrial, mobile, marine and generator applications.
fullDescription: Lombardini is verified through its official service and product portal as an Italian engine identity within Rehlko's engine portfolio.
The published range includes KDI, KSD, KDW, KD, LDW and LD diesel engine families, together with technical literature for current and out-of-production industrial and marine engines.

profiles.shortDescription: LS Mecapion develops servo motors, servo drives, motion controllers, robots and linear-motion modules for industrial automation.
fullDescription: LS Mecapion is verified through its official corporate website as a South Korean automation manufacturer based in Daegu.
Its documented range covers rotary and direct-drive servo motors, EtherCAT servo drives, motion controllers, Cartesian robots, smart actuator modules, linear motors and industrial PCs.

profiles.shortDescription: Parker Lucifer is a fluid-control brand for solenoid valves, coils and valve accessories used with gases and liquids.
fullDescription: Lucifer is verified through Parker Hannifin's official catalogs as a retained fluid-control valve brand acquired by Parker.
The documented range includes direct-acting and pilot-operated two-, three- and four-way solenoid valves, high-pressure and NAMUR configurations, oil-burner valves, coils and electrical accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Lundberg Tech designs automated trim, label-matrix and edge-waste handling systems for converting and production lines.
fullDescription: Lundberg Tech is verified through its official website as a Danish manufacturer of automated industrial waste-handling systems.

Its product scope includes granulators, all-in-one units and central systems that collect, transport and process trim, die-cut, label-matrix and edge waste from converting, extrusion and printing machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: M&C TechGroup develops gas-sampling, gas-conditioning and process-analysis equipment for industrial measurement systems.
fullDescription: M&C TechGroup is verified through its official website as a German gas-analysis technology manufacturer headquartered in Ratingen and now part of MSA Safety.
Its portfolio spans gas sample probes, coolers, filters, sample-gas pumps, conditioning systems, connectors, fittings and gas analyzers for continuous process and emissions monitoring.

profiles.shortDescription: MacDue designs automatic packaging machines, handling equipment and end-of-line systems for industrial products and materials.
fullDescription: MacDue is verified through its official website as an Italian automated-packaging machinery manufacturer founded in 1981 and based in Bologna.

Its systems cover tissue and folded products, thermoformed trays and cups, insulation panels, shape-moulded products and household goods, with bundlers, case packers, palletisers, conveyors and handling modules.

profiles.shortDescription: MacGregor Pusnes covers mooring and loading systems for offshore units, terminals and marine operations.
fullDescription: Pusnes is verified through MacGregor's official product literature as a retained mooring-system identity within the MacGregor portfolio.
The documented range includes mooring winches, chain and wire systems, fairleads, chain stoppers and related equipment engineered for floating production units and offshore hook-up operations.

profiles.shortDescription: Machine Concepts designs custom machinery, coil-processing systems, press-room equipment and industrial automation for metal manufacturing.
fullDescription: Machine Concepts is verified through its official website as a United States custom-machine builder based in Minster, Ohio.

Its documented capabilities include coil processing, precision straightening, press-room auxiliary equipment, mill products, custom automation, robotic integration and rebuilds for steel, aluminium and other manufacturing operations.

profiles.shortDescription: Mack Valves manufactures industrial valves for water, cryogenic, steam, fire-protection, defence and oxygen-service applications.
fullDescription: Mack Valves is verified through its official website as an Australian industrial-valve manufacturer with more than eighty years of operating history.
Its product scope includes automatic control valves, cryogenic valves, general and steam valves, fire-protection products, oxygen-service valves and strainers for infrastructure and process duties.

profiles.shortDescription: MADAS manufactures gas safety, pressure-regulation and filtration equipment, including solenoid valves, regulators, filters and gas trains.
fullDescription: MADAS is verified through its official website as an Italian manufacturer based in San Pietro di Legnago, Verona.

Its published portfolio covers automatic and manual-reset gas solenoid valves, pressure regulators, gas filters, safety and relief valves, oil shut-off products, pressure switches, accessories and assembled gas trains.

profiles.shortDescription: MADO manufactures grinders, cutters, band saws, extrusion machines and portioning systems for professional food processing.
fullDescription: MADO is verified through its official website as a German food-processing machinery manufacturer based in Dornhan and established in 1960.

Its documented portfolio covers manual and automatic mincers, industrial grinders, mixer grinders, cutters, band saws, knife sharpeners, extrusion grinders and portioning equipment for meat and food plants.

profiles.shortDescription: MAGNET-SCHULTZ develops electromagnetic actuators, solenoids, valve technology, sensors and control electronics for industrial systems.
fullDescription: MAGNET-SCHULTZ is verified through its official website as a German electromagnetic actuator and sensor manufacturer based in Memmingen.

Its standard and custom portfolio includes linear and rotary solenoids, locking units, holding magnets, vibrators, hydraulic and pneumatic valve solenoids, proportional valves, sensors, electronics and ATEX or IECEx configurations.

profiles.shortDescription: Magnetek is a Columbus McKinnon power and motion-control brand for crane drives, radio controls, brakes and power-delivery systems.
fullDescription: Magnetek is verified through Columbus McKinnon's official motion-control site as a retained power and motion-control brand.

Its documented portfolio includes AC and DC motor controls, variable-frequency drives, radio remote controls, pushbutton stations, industrial brakes, festoon systems, cable reels and crane-automation components.

profiles.shortDescription: Magnetic Technologies designs magnetic brakes, clutches, couplings and tension-control assemblies for industrial motion systems.
fullDescription: Magnetic Technologies is verified through its official website as a United States magnetic motion-control manufacturer founded in 1984 and based in Putnam, Connecticut.
The documented range includes permanent-magnet and current-controlled hysteresis brakes and clutches, magnetic couplings, capping heads, power supplies, payoff stands and constant-tension assemblies.

profiles.shortDescription: Christian Maier manufactures rotary joints for transferring water, air, steam, oil, vacuum and other media into rotating equipment.
fullDescription: Christian Maier is verified through its official website as a German rotary-joint manufacturer headquartered in Heidenheim and marking one hundred years in 2025.

Its rotary-joint portfolio includes single- and multi-passage designs for water, air, steam, hydraulic oil, heat-transfer oil, vacuum and special media, with standard DS, MP, DX, DQ, M, H and DP series.

profiles.shortDescription: MAINA manufactures heavy-duty power-transmission components, including universal shafts, gear spindles, safety devices and gear couplings.
fullDescription: MAINA is verified through its official website as an Italian power-transmission equipment manufacturer based in Asti.
Its documented portfolio covers universal shafts, gear spindles, overload and safety devices, and flexible gear couplings engineered for steel plants and other heavy industrial machinery.

profiles.shortDescription: Makita develops electric, cordless and pneumatic tools, outdoor power equipment and accessories for professional work applications.
fullDescription: Makita is verified through Makita Corporation's official global website as a Japanese power-tool and equipment manufacturer.

Its international product portfolio spans cordless and corded tools for drilling, fastening, cutting, grinding and material processing, together with outdoor power equipment, dust-management products and tool accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: MANN-FILTER supplies aftermarket air, oil, fuel, cabin and hydraulic filters for vehicles, mobile machinery and industrial engines.
fullDescription: MANN-FILTER is verified through its official website as a MANN+HUMMEL filtration brand serving vehicle and machinery aftermarket applications.
Its documented product range includes air, oil, fuel, cabin-air, hydraulic, coolant, transmission-oil and urea filters, plus air-dryer cartridges, separators and other special filtration products.

profiles.shortDescription: MANN+HUMMEL develops filtration systems for mobility, industrial machinery, indoor air and water-treatment applications.
fullDescription: MANN+HUMMEL is verified through its official corporate website as a German filtration manufacturer founded in 1941 and headquartered in Ludwigsburg.
Its portfolio covers vehicle and off-road filtration, industrial equipment filters, air-quality systems, water and membrane treatment, filtration materials and digital monitoring products.

profiles.shortDescription: Manuli Hydraulics manufactures hydraulic hoses, fittings, connectors and system components for mobile and industrial fluid-power applications.
fullDescription: Manuli Hydraulics is verified through its official website as an industrial fluid-power hose and fitting manufacturer.

Its documented range covers universal, application-oriented and extreme-duty hydraulic hoses, two-piece and one-piece fittings, quick couplings and engineered connection products for construction, mining, agriculture, drilling and forestry equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Manuvit designs industrial handling and lifting equipment for drums, coils, pallets, reels, cylinders and other loads.
fullDescription: Manuvit is verified through its official website as a French designer and manufacturer of material-handling systems based in Normandy.

Its product range includes stackers, pallet trucks, lifting tables, trolleys, manipulators, clamps, vacuum lifters and application-specific equipment for drums, coils, boxes, reels, gas cylinders and long loads.

profiles.officialName: MAPAL Dr. Kress SE & Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: MAPAL develops precision cutting, clamping, actuating and tool-management systems for industrial machining processes.
fullDescription: MAPAL is verified through its official website as a German manufacturer of machining tools and process solutions.

Its documented portfolio includes reaming and fine-boring tools, drilling and countersinking systems, milling and turning tools, clamping equipment, actuating tools, setting and measuring devices, dispensing systems and related services.

profiles.shortDescription: MAPRO manufactures compressors, blowers, exhausters, vacuum pumps and fans for air, biogas, natural gas and industrial process gases.
fullDescription: MAPRO is verified through its official website as an Italian manufacturer of gas-handling machinery based in Nova Milanese and producing since 1959.
Its range covers rotary-vane compressors and vacuum pumps, side-channel and multistage centrifugal blowers, positive-displacement blowers, centrifugal fans and sequential gas-mixing systems.
